sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The shape only requires ship-level iceClass evidence and does not encode the clause 8 obligations: conditional applicability by the relevant ice-class values, the warning triangle’s vertical relationship and 1,000 mm offset with deck-line cap, 300 mm sides, the alternative 540 mm abaft positioning, 5–8 mm plate thickness, welding to the ship side, permitted reflecting colours/visibility, and letter-dimension equality. Add constraints for every obligation on the authoritative owners, using proper alternatives and units; canonical marking, position, dimension, material, attachment, colour, and visibility terms must be located.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Do not make iceClass presence and membership the compliance obligation.
